privacyPage.title: Privacy and children's photos
privacyPage.lead: Your child's photo is a trust. This page explains plainly what we do with it and who sees it.

sections.p: Your child's first name, gender, age, one to three photos, and their drawing if you add one. We don't ask for family names or schools for parent books.
No photo is uploaded before a guardian's explicit consent; we keep a copy of the consent text and its date.

Original photos are stored encrypted in private storage and are only opened through links that expire within 15 minutes. Originals and the drawing are deleted automatically within 24 hours of approving the character; abandoned drafts after 30 days. You can ask us to delete all of your child's data at any time, and we delete the photos, character and books immediately.
We never send photos to analytics or advertising services. They go only to the AI providers that draw the book, through their paid APIs:
Anthropic (Claude) writes and reviews the story. Its commercial terms: "Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services" (Commercial Terms, effective June 17, 2025).

We draw through fal.ai with Google's Nano Banana 2 model. Google's terms for paid services: Google doesn't use prompts or responses to improve its products and keeps them for a limited time only to detect abuse. With fal we switch off request-history storage, send images inside the request instead of uploading them to their file servers, and set any generated file to expire within 15 minutes. fal's data processing addendum limits processing of personal data to our instructions.
You can ask for a copy of your data or have it deleted at any time by contacting us by email or support WhatsApp.

howPage.lead: From a photo on your phone to a printed book at your door. This is how we make the story book and the activity books, and what we promise along the way.
howPage.photoAlt: A child on their first day at kindergarten holding their book
howPage.storyLead: Five steps; the three that are yours take under ten minutes.

storySteps.title: A photo from your phone
storySteps.body: A clear photo of your child's face, their name and age, and your consent as a guardian. Add one of their drawings if you like.

storySteps.title: We draw their character, you approve it
storySteps.body: We show you the character card: your child from the front and in two poses. We don't continue until you say "that's my child".

storySteps.title: Free preview
storySteps.body: Flip through every page on your phone, edit the words or redraw a page, before you pay anything.

storySteps.title: We print locally
storySteps.body: Full color on thick paper, hardcover or softcover as you chose, from a printer near you.

storySteps.title: Delivered in {min}–{max} working days
storySteps.body: To your door, cash on delivery. You follow your order step by step.

howPage.privacyTitle: Your child's photo is safe with us
howPage.privacyLead: We use the photo to draw the character, then we delete it.

privacy.title: Deleted automatically
privacy.body: The original photo is deleted from our servers within 24 hours of approving your child's character.

privacy.title: Guardian consent
privacy.body: We never start without your explicit consent. In kindergartens, every parent consents themselves.

privacy.title: No training on your children's photos
privacy.body: We never use your children's photos to train any AI model.

privacy.title: Delete everything with one tap
privacy.body: From your account you can permanently delete the child, their books and their data at any time.

howPage.activityLead: The Foundation workbook, My First Learning Journey, and My Adventures with My Family.
howPage.activityPhotoAlt: A child tracing letters in their workbook

activitySteps.title: Your child's name and character
activitySteps.body: The same character we draw for the story, or we draw it now from a photo.

activitySteps.title: We put them in the pages
activitySteps.body: Their name in the exercises and the certificate, their character on the cover. In the family book, the family's names appear in the missions.

activitySteps.title: We print and deliver
activitySteps.body: Spiral binding that opens flat, cash on delivery.

howPage.voiceBody: Record the story in Mom's or Grandma's voice from your phone, and we print a QR code in the book so your child can hear the story in your voice, whenever they like.
howPage.voicePhotoAlt: A grandmother recording the story in her voice for her granddaughter
howPage.faqLead: Didn't find your answer? Message us.

faq.q: Will the drawing really look like my child?
faq.a: Before drawing the story we show you a "character card": your child from the front and in two poses. We don't continue until you say "that's my child".

faq.q: How long until the book arrives?
faq.a: Once you approve the pages we print the book and send it. Delivery time depends on your zone and is shown on the pricing page; you follow your order step by step from your account.
We deliver to your door in West Bank cities and in Jerusalem. The zones, fees and delivery times are on the pricing page.
Cash on delivery, to the courier. No card and no prepayment.

faq.q: What if I don't like the pages?
faq.a: You review every page before printing and can redraw any of them. The preview is free, and you don't pay until you like the book.

faq.q: Can I edit the story's text?
faq.a: Yes. In the review step you edit each page's text as you like, or restore it with one tap.

faq.q: What happens to my child's photo?
faq.a: We use it only to draw their character, and it is deleted automatically within 24 hours of approving the character. We never use it to train any model and never share it.

faq.q: How are the activity books personalized?
faq.a: A cover with their character and name, and their name inside the exercises and the certificate. We use the same character we draw for the story, so it only needs drawing once.

faq.q: What if the book arrives with a printing defect?
faq.a: We reprint it for free when the fault is ours. Message us with a photo of the page.

howPage.closingBody: Choose a story or an activity book, and leave the rest to us.
